additionPolicy.rules: No overwrite or duplicate of existing ID; no insertion into a league or qualification from ranking alone. Verify active status and native/global slots, world isolation, OG cache and CAR before registration. Existing historical source labels/points unchanged. Existing OG national routines must resolve modern roster independently from shared 9697 data. Never create club-key for a national. FIFA codes are stable external keys, not OG numbers.
